title: Independently verify all patterns in the T740 six-skip packing cap
body:
PR3054 supplies an author-checked fixed-inventory packing cap; the prior independent report covers the complete profile and partial native replay without stating an independent all-pattern cap check. This adds a separate executable audit of that specific implication, executing no predecessor Python.

- Enumerates all 2,551 legal bin patterns, solves the exact primal/dual equations, and certifies 12 identically tight plus 2,539 strictly positive reduced costs throughout the six-skip root bracket. The smallest certified lower bound exceeds 0.0040828 in H units.
- Uses dyadic Euler-product exponential bounds and inverse bisection, independently of the retained logarithm/Taylor engine. Reconstructs the complete candidate profile from both actual provider inventories and the primal idle counts.
- Derives the integer annihilator and `20*N_[9,9,9,9,9]@48 = 1341*T`; hence 20 divides T and 740 is the first eligible multiple of 74. This corroborates Petalas's existing cap/divisibility result, rather than claiming a new one.

Base is current canonical main `18aacb215fc3717b06be8ceb9fca62aeca0d3e99`; input pins resolve at PR3054 head `4773c3ea67b471415870e38411fae313ec44a675`. Only `research/t740-independent-packing-cap/` is added. Its README supplies the proof, source bindings, overlap coverage, existing checks and open next question. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18985875).

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay passes; all 20 tests pass in normal and optimized mode. Python 3.14 reproduces the exact receipt and passes the controls. Controls include stale roots, infeasible/duplicate/negative primal entries, omitted patterns/idle charges, mass-preserving profile corruption and a rank-44 cost fault absent from the candidate histogram. Metadata/pins pass; all 11 package/input publication-byte comparisons pass at `de12c885fb742735af90b496d30760b639fd6e5a`. Exact command/environment output is in VALIDATION.json.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t740-independent-packing-cap
```

Scope: the fixed chronology-free additive-bin relaxation and its integrality condition. Word action, literal fill/owner windows, physical stock/prefixes, native execution, full admission and outer transfer are not checked here. The prior independent full replay's final admission gate remains open. No new kappa, selected-frontier change or supplier admission.

Credit Nick Petalas (PR3024/3030/3054 cap/composition), dcharb78 (PR3042 skips), Jeremy Kothe (PR3015), Marius-Paul Dumitrean (PR2979), Ross Richardson ([prior independent report](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18983422)) and the retained native/geometry/owner lineage. Arham Tahir, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human or proof-kernel review claimed.
